read_colmap_cameras: read COLMAP camera extrinsics and intrinsics to build a list of Camera objects from an images folder
read_colmap_scene_info: read a COLMAP scene path to produce a SceneInfo object with train, test, and validation camera splits
convert_points3d_to_ply: convert COLMAP points3D binary or text format to a PLY point cloud file for the scene
split_cameras_for_eval: split COLMAP cameras into train and test sets using an LLFF-style holdout stride for evaluation
parse_colmap_intrinsics: parse COLMAP camera intrinsics for SIMPLE_PINHOLE or PINHOLE models and compute horizontal and vertical FOV
